name: fuku
description: Run, inspect, debug and stop local services with fuku from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run, inspect, debug and stop local services with fuku
interface.longDescription: Let Codex drive fuku for local development: start a profile in the background, attach to a running fuku, read bounded logs, check and restart one service through the API and stop fuku.
defaultPrompt: Start the default fuku profile in the background and report failed services
Read the recent logs of a fuku service and explain why it failed
Restart one fuku service and confirm that it runs
